name: Sci-Fi Energy, Holograms & Power
when_to_use: An AI agent or robot appearing, a logo forming from particles, unlock or upgrade moments, futuristic UI worlds, before/after transformations.

sounds.name: Biohazard Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry, looping sci-fi alarm buzzer that swells into each cycle; use under a warning or containment-breach style beat.

sounds.name: Concise Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A bright, crisp looping sci-fi buzzer with an instant attack; use for a sharp system-warning or error-screen moment.

sounds.name: Cookies Stolen Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A short 1.6 s noisy sci-fi buzzer loop; use for a quick security-breach or 'data stolen' warning beat.

sounds.name: Decontamination Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A 10 s dry sci-fi alarm loop like a lab decontamination cycle; use as a tense warning bed under a 'something is wrong' section.

sounds.name: HDD Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A loud 10 s dry sci-fi alarm loop with a machine-like, hard-drive character; use under a system-failure or crash beat.

sounds.name: Incoming Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A 2 s dry sci-fi alert buzzer loop; use for an 'incoming' warning or a trouble alert popping on screen.

sounds.name: Incoming Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a 2 s sci-fi alert buzzer loop; use for an incoming-threat warning with more space.

sounds.name: Invaders Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry looping sci-fi alarm buzzer for an 'under attack' or intruder warning beat.

sounds.name: Not A Drill Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry, mono looping emergency alarm with an instant start; use for an urgent 'this is not a drill' warning or a hook pattern interrupt.

sounds.name: Not A Drill Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of an urgent emergency alarm loop; use for a big, roomy 'not a drill' warning moment.

sounds.name: Stern Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A stern, full-band 3.2 s sci-fi buzzer loop with a hard attack; use for a firm 'denied' or warning beat.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 01
sounds.desc: A 21-second mid-toned digital whir that sounds like a drill, for a layer under an AI building something or a machine-at-work moment.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 02
sounds.desc: A steady 6.6-second sub-heavy digital drill grind, for a short heavy machine layer under a 'building the system' moment.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 03
sounds.desc: A quieter 13.6-second low digital drill rumble, for a subtle mechanical bed under a screen recording of an agent at work.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 01
sounds.desc: A sharp bright pneumatic hiss that fades over half a second, like a sci-fi door sliding open, for a panel, card or window opening.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 02
sounds.desc: An alternate half-second sci-fi door-open air hiss with an instant attack, for a UI panel or hologram card opening.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 03
sounds.desc: A third bright pneumatic door-open hiss that decays quickly, for revealing a futuristic panel or screen.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 01
sounds.desc: A rocket thruster ignites over about a second, then roars in a steady full-range burn; trim it for a launch or blast-off moment, or as a power-up layer.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 03
sounds.desc: The brightest thruster ignition, with sub weight and airy hiss, ramping into a steady roaring burn; trim for a launch or power-up moment.

sounds.name: Biohazard Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a looping sci-fi alarm buzzer that sounds like it fills a facility; use for a big warning beat or tension bed.

sounds.name: Concise Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant take on a bright, crisp sci-fi buzzer loop; use for a system-warning beat that needs more space.

sounds.name: Cookies Stolen Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a short noisy sci-fi buzzer loop; use for a breach or hacking warning with more room.

sounds.name: Decontamination Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a 10 s lab decontamination alarm loop; use as a big, roomy warning bed.

sounds.name: HDD Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a machine-like 10 s sci-fi alarm loop; use for a roomy system-failure warning.

sounds.name: Invaders Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of an intruder-style sci-fi alarm loop; use for a roomy 'under attack' warning or tension bed.

sounds.name: Stern Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a stern 3.2 s sci-fi buzzer loop; use for a 'denied' or warning beat that needs more space.

sounds.name: Brrr-Bop Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry looping sci-fi buzzer with a 'brrr-bop' rhythm; use for an error or 'wrong way' warning beat.

sounds.name: Brrr-Bop Alarm 02
sounds.desc: A reverberant looping sci-fi buzzer with a 'brrr-bop' rhythm; use for a roomy error or warning beat.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 04
sounds.desc: A deep 21-second digital drill drone that slowly fades, for a low mechanical layer under a build or transformation sequence.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 05
sounds.desc: The darkest 20-second digital drill rumble, fading out at the end, for a heavy machine layer under a dramatic build.

sounds.name: Heavy Laser Blast 01
sounds.desc: A big, bass-heavy sci-fi laser blast decaying over 0.7 s that clearly sounds like a game weapon, for a playful energy or power accent.

sounds.name: Heavy Laser Blast 02
sounds.desc: A darker, heavy laser blast with a strong low body, for a sci-fi energy accent on a gamified beat.

sounds.name: Heavy Laser Blast 03
sounds.desc: The brightest heavy laser blast in the set, for a game-style power or energy hit.

sounds.name: Small Laser Zap 01
sounds.desc: A bright, quick quarter-second laser zap, for a small HUD element firing in or a sci-fi text accent.

sounds.name: Small Laser Zap 02
sounds.desc: A third-of-a-second small laser zap with a mid-bright tone, for a quick sci-fi blip as an icon appears.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 02
sounds.desc: Darker, more low-end thruster ignition that swells for a second, then holds a rumbling burn; use under a launch or 'we shipped it' beat.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 04
sounds.desc: Brighter, hissier thruster ignition that ramps in and sustains a roaring burn; use as a launch or power-up layer and trim to length.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 05
sounds.desc: Deep, muffled thruster ignition that builds over a second into a heavy rumbling burn; sits under a launch or big-moment build.
